title: BJP announces nationwide demonstrations over Congress chief Kharge remarks

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge's remarks regarding Prime Minister Narendra Modi's father.
tea.want: BJP demands accountability and condemns what it describes as indecent and offensive personal insults against the Prime Minister's family.
tea.changed: Oct 25: The BJP announced a nationwide demonstration across all state headquarters following remarks made by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna.

summary: Following controversial remarks made by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna regarding Prime Minister Narendra Modi's father during an event commemorating Bihar's first Chief Minister, the Bharatiya Janata Party announced plans for nationwide demonstrations. Union Home Minister Amit Shah and other party leaders condemned the remarks as a breach of political decorum, asserting that the opposition frequently resorts to personal attacks on the Prime Minister and his family due to ongoing electoral frustrations. According to party announcements, demonstrations are scheduled to take place across all state headquarters.
demands: Political decorum and an end to personal insults against the Prime Minister and his family
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge made controversial remarks about the Prime Minister's father during an event in Patna.
The BJP announced nationwide demonstrations across all state headquarters for Monday against the remarks.
